shared_tier1.scope: Resolved local branch offsets, preserved alignment-byte counts and masked hexadecimal values of at least ten digits. Instruction-text comparison only; not binary identity or a performance claim.

review: All 66 emitted bodies have complete boundaries and resolved internal labels. Three-row IG15 and two-row IG06 keep twelve/eight ordered AVX2 FMA accumulators with no vector stack spills in the main reductions; eight-wide tails use FMA, masked tails retain separate multiply/add. Stack vector accesses construct tail masks. Raw remainder keeps vector FMA and separate scalar multiply/add. Short helper Tier1 inlines packing and raw remainder, calls its scratch-return finally at IG23 before odd-row work at IG24-32, and uses original B. Existing five common Tier1 instruction streams match after resolving label offsets and masking pointer-sized hexadecimal values. This is not binary identity. New dispatcher Tier1 is 4092 bytes because the JIT inlines the general route; original general remains 3712 bytes. This inlining behavior requires fresh performance/regression evidence. Four copied kernels each emit one FullOpts body, without Tier0/OSR replacements. Exact compiled scope and numerical results admit only the component experiment.
